race.comment: MR RIBTICKLER (6) fought on gamely off a wide run for third when resuming here nearly 3 weeks ago, and he gets a big swing in his draw this time. He strips fitter and is the one to beat. ELROND (3) turned some average form around with a sound run for second by a neck at Balaklava 9 days ago. He has a wide gate this time, but can still figure in the top 4. CRAZYABOUTZOU (14) will be peaking third up, and a lot of horses that got back at Halidon in their last starts can be forgiven. Stick with her. EMBERANCE (10) cops a wide draw for her peak run third up from a spell, but this field is not strong, and with the aid of a 3kg claim, she is worth including in all combos.
